entries.headline: Assassin's Creed Valhalla Adds New Game+ and Upgraded PSSR on PS5 Pro
entries.summary: The free Most Requested Update is live on PS5 and PS5 Pro, adding New Game+, two new achievements, and an Enhanced Progression Mode; the upgraded PSSR optimization is exclusive to PS5 Pro.
entries.verification: The opened first-party PlayStation Blog post confirms the update, features, and PlayStation platform scope.
entries.timeNote: The selected source was published at 2026-11-05 22:00 Beijing time, within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: BALL x PIT and More Join Xbox Free Play Days Through November 8
entries.summary: Xbox Free Play Days runs November 5–8 for Game Pass Ultimate, Premium, and Essential members, with PAYDAY 3, BALL x PIT, Deceive Inc., and other games in the lineup.
entries.verification: The opened first-party Xbox Wire announcement confirms the dates, membership tiers, and lineup.
entries.timeNote: The selected source was published at 2026-11-06 00:00 Beijing time, within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Rockstar Releases 39 New Grand Theft Auto VI Screenshots
entries.summary: Rockstar released 39 new screenshots two weeks before the November 19 launch, showing Vice City, Jason, Lucia, and other scenes; two independent outlets reported the same official asset drop.
entries.verification: The opened IGN and VGC reports independently confirm the count and release context.
entries.timeNote: The selected source was published at 2026-11-05 23:34 Beijing time, within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Bolt and the Floating Castle Demo Launches on Steam
entries.summary: Orca Studio released a Steam demo on November 5 for its 2D exploration action game, whose central machine can alter character abilities and object properties; the full game is planned for 2027 with Japanese support.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report confirms the demo, platform, mechanic, and broad 2027 release window.
entries.timeNote: The selected source was published at 2026-11-05 11:00 Beijing time, within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Mugen Sakura Rokaku / CRYMELIGHT: Mugen Sakura Rokaku and CRYMELIGHT Developers Discuss Their Shared Launch Date
entries.summary: Both action games launched on November 5. CRYMELIGHT's Steam version was delayed by Valve review, and the teams plan a commemorative collaboration bundle when it arrives.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON developer interview directly records the shared launch date, Steam delay, and collaboration plan.
entries.timeNote: The selected source was published at 2026-11-05 19:17 Beijing time, within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Game Studio Acquisition and Closure Study: Study Says About One-Third of Acquired Game Studios Have Closed
entries.summary: Sebastian Cardoso tracked more than 300 game studios acquired since 2000 and reported that roughly one-third had closed as of October 30, 2026; the result should be read within the methodology of his own dataset.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report identifies the author, sample, cutoff date, and finding; the copy attributes the claim to the study.
entries.timeNote: The selected source was published at 2026-11-05 18:14 Beijing time, within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Massive Effect: The BioWare Story: BioWare's Final Two Years Feature in a 2027 Documentary
entries.summary: Massive Effect: The BioWare Story chronicles BioWare's final two years and is planned for 2027 with Canada's Super Channel involved in production; online distribution remains unconfirmed.
entries.verification: The opened IGN report confirms the title, filmed period, production context, and broad 2027 window while noting distribution uncertainty.
entries.timeNote: The selected source was published at 2026-11-06 03:48 Beijing time, within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: CygamesEdge Action Game 崩落の国 Launches on PC, Switch 2, and PS5
entries.summary: 崩落の国 launched November 5 on PC via Steam, Nintendo Switch 2, and PS5, challenging players to descend through a continuously collapsing world tree.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report confirms the date, three platforms, and core premise.
entries.timeNote: The selected source was published at 2026-11-05 13:03 Beijing time, within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: NBA 2K27 Arcade Edition Launches on Apple Arcade
entries.summary: 2K launched the Apple Arcade edition on November 5 for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision, and Apple TV, featuring all 30 NBA and 15 WNBA teams.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report confirms the launch date, supported Apple devices, and team counts.

entries.headline: DAMON and BABY Free Update Arrives February 18, 2027
entries.summary: The free RISE OF THE ORACLE update arrives February 18, 2027 alongside PS5 and Switch physical editions. A digital Switch 2 version is planned, but remains undated.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report relays Arc System Works' announcement and distinguishes the dated update from the undated Switch 2 version.
entries.timeNote: The selected source was published at 2026-11-05 14:29 Beijing time, within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Famitsu Japan Sales: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort Leads Famitsu's Weekly Single-SKU Chart
entries.summary: For October 26–November 1 in Japan, Nintendo Switch Sports Resort sold 23,466 physical copies as the top single SKU, while Final Fantasy Resonance totaled 34,068 across platforms. Switch 2 hardware reached 68,733 units.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report reproduces Famitsu's estimates; the copy distinguishes a single SKU from a cross-platform total and keeps the hardware figure within Japan.
entries.timeNote: The selected source was published at 2026-11-05 21:06 Beijing time, within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: MAGES. Will Reveal a New Girls und Panzer Console Game on November 14
entries.summary: MAGES. plans to announce a Girls und Panzer console game at the Oarai event on November 14; gameplay and specific platforms remain undisclosed.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report confirms the planned reveal date and explicitly notes that details remain unknown.
entries.timeNote: The selected source was published at 2026-11-05 14:57 Beijing time, within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: DEAD OR ALIVE 6 Last Round DLC 18 Adds Four New Costumes
entries.summary: DLC 18, the Minato Weekend Mission set, launched November 5 with four costumes for Minato; the publisher also teased a free 30th-anniversary update.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report relays the publisher's DLC number, costume count, and update teaser without adding a platform or date for the free update.

entries.headline: Pokémon Pokopia's Second Paid DLC Arrives December 9
entries.summary: The second paid add-on, Doki Doki Decoration, arrives December 9 on Nintendo Switch 2, adding accessories for Ditto and the town's Pokémon.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report relays The Pokémon Company's announcement and confirms the DLC number, date, platform, and customization theme.
